I’ll update the experiment metric identity handling for both promotion and shared-metric-only updates, then revise the agent guidance that suggests the collision-prone flow. I’ll keep this scoped to code and natural regression coverage, without installing dependencies or running tests.
The relevant path is the experiment service, with existing UUID-normalization coverage already nearby. I also found the exact analytics skill language that encourages promoting and reattaching an inline metric; I’ll revise that guidance alongside the backend safeguard.
Because I’m adding regression coverage, I’m using the repository’s test-authoring guidance to ensure the tests target the two user-visible regressions rather than implementation details.
The service already prevents a collision when an inline list is submitted in the same request. The remaining gap is exactly the saved-metrics-only update: it never normalizes the stored inline arrays against the newly attached shared UUIDs. I’ll normalize those stored arrays only in that case, so existing inline metric identities are regenerated rather than changing the reusable shared metric.
The patch now covers the saved-metrics-only path and adds a regression test that promotes an inline metric through the shared-metric service, then attaches it without resending `metrics`. The inline UUID is regenerated, while the shared metric keeps its identifier and the ordering contains both.
I’m doing a final comment-quality pass using the repository’s required code-comment guidance, because the backend change includes an explanatory guard comment.
Implemented the shared/inline metric UUID safeguard.

- Saved-metrics-only updates now regenerate any colliding stored inline metric UUIDs, preserving shared metric UUIDs for reuse across experiments. [experiment_service.py](/Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/bench/worktrees/posthog-codex-gpt56-2/products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py:3694)
- Added regression coverage for promoting an inline metric and attaching it without resending inline metrics. [test_experiment_service.py](/Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/bench/worktrees/posthog-codex-gpt56-2/products/experiments/backend/test/test_experiment_service.py:6157)
- Updated experiment analytics guidance to replace an inline metric when promoting it, rather than retaining a duplicate inline copy. [SKILL.md](/Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/bench/worktrees/posthog-codex-gpt56-2/products/experiments/skills/configuring-experiment-analytics/SKILL.md:112)

+    def test_attaching_promoted_metric_regenerates_colliding_inline_uuid(self):
+        self._create_flag(key="promoted-saved-metric-collision")
+        metric_uuid = "43bfb66a-51f5-48d0-a87e-bde2b4c958a6"
+        metric = {
+            "kind": "ExperimentMetric",
+            "metric_type": "mean",
+            "uuid": metric_uuid,
+            "source": {"kind": "EventsNode", "event": "$pageview"},
+        }
+        service = self._service()
+        experiment = service.create_experiment(
+            name="Inline metric to promote",
+            feature_flag_key="promoted-saved-metric-collision",
+            allow_unknown_events=True,
+            metrics=[metric],
+        )
+        saved_metric = ExperimentSavedMetricService(team=self.team, user=self.user).create_saved_metric(
+            name="Promoted metric", query=metric
+        )
+
+        updated = service.update_experiment(
+            experiment,
+            {"saved_metrics_ids": [{"id": saved_metric.id, "metadata": {"type": "primary"}}]},
+            allow_unknown_events=True,
+        )
+
+        assert updated.metrics is not None
+        inline_uuid = updated.metrics[0]["uuid"]
+        assert inline_uuid != metric_uuid
+        UUID(inline_uuid)
+        assert saved_metric.query["uuid"] == metric_uuid
+        assert updated.primary_metrics_ordered_uuids is not None
+        assert set(updated.primary_metrics_ordered_uuids) == {inline_uuid, metric_uuid}
+
